caption: Seen from inside a dim shop, the open doorway to the sunlit street stands out as a bright rectangle and the floor near the door is lit.

sa.check: The view is from inside a shop.
The open doorway to the street stands out as a bright rectangle.
The floor near the door is lit.

pc.expect: The interior is dim relative to the doorway, the floor near the door is lit, and it grows darker deeper in.
pc.fail: The back of the shop is as bright as the door; or the floor by the door is dark; or the light comes from the back.

pc.expect: The interior's colours are the same, only dimmer.
pc.fail: Objects change colour with depth; or the doorway is a colour; or the floor changes colour.

pc.expect: The lit area stays put with the door and sun fixed.
pc.fail: It wanders; or flickers; or the door moves by itself.

pc.expect: The bright rectangle is the doorway's shape.
pc.fail: It is round; or splits; or is larger than the door.
A second doorway appears; or it vanishes; or the light becomes solid.
Shelves rearrange; or the door changes; or the street changes.
